body: Vision language models (VLMs) are used in creative tasks such as visual storytelling, design ideation, art interpretation, and advertising. Yet we lack principled ways to measure the lateral reasoning of these models compared to human potential. We introduce CREATE, a semi-automatically constructed benchmark containing 155 visual Remote Associates Test problems. These problems require a solver to find an underlying connection among three seemingly dissimilar images. We conduct a human study (N=25) to validate and ground the quality of our benchmark, and evaluate 11 VLMs. Our findings show that most VLMs underperform humans on this task. Our experiments indicate that the associative ability of VLMs depends on the cue concepts provided in the text and does not universally extend to visual puzzles.
summaryZh: 本文针对视觉语言模型（VLM）的创造力评估提出了CREATE基准测试。该基准包含155个视觉远程联想测试问题，旨在衡量模型在处理视觉拼图时的横向推理能力。通过对11个主流VLM的评估，研究发现当前模型在联想能力上仍显著落后于人类，且其表现高度依赖于文本提示，缺乏通用的视觉联想逻辑。该研究为理解和提升多模态模型的创造性思维提供了关键评估框架。

glossary.explanationZh: 视觉语言模型，能够处理和理解图像与文本的多模态模型。
远程联想测试，一种衡量创造性思维和横向推理能力的心理学测试。
横向推理，指通过非传统、创造性的方式解决问题的思维过程。
基准测试，用于评估模型性能的标准数据集和评估方法。
